# CrystalView

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** CrystalView

## What it does

CrystalView lets you change how nearby End Crystals are drawn so they're easier to read at a glance — useful in crystal PvP where stacked or oddly placed crystals can clutter your view. You can shrink the model, reposition it, and tone down or speed up its motion to suit your taste.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/crystalview). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
